text:
marta: Quick question — I need to give a platform engineer read access to prod logs for a live debugging session, but logs must remain redacted (PII removed). Want to propose a minimal role and JIT flow. Thoughts?

alex: which logs specifically? api/gateway traces, llm traces, or app logs?

marta: mostly llm-traces bucket + the tracing UI. Not full exports, just console view with fields redacted.

priya: Can we avoid org-level role? Project-scoped is safer. Recommend a custom project role that grants `logging.logEntries.list` + `logging.logEntries.read` on the prod project but use a log view filter to hide PII.

marta: here's a rough IAM snippet I sketched for the custom role (not final):
```json
{
  "title": "Prod Debug Redacted Log Viewer",
  "permissions": [
    "logging.logEntries.list",
    "logging.logEntries.read",
    "resourcemanager.projects.get"
  ],
  "description": "Read-only access to view redacted logs in prod for short-term debugging"
}
```

alex: That looks fine. +1 to project-scoped. We should pair with an enforced log-view filter (server-side) and a requirement that any session is requested via JIT with an audit annotation.

priya: To be explicit: JIT token via our JIT service with STS token TTL = 1h, require reason and ticket ID. Add automatic masking on the UI side too.

marta: Who signs off on creating the custom role and the JIT request template? I can submit a PR but need approver for prod IAM change.

oncall-bot: Reminder: all IAM changes touching prod must be approved by security-eng and recorded in the change log. See https://redwood.internal/iam-guidelines :lock: 

alex: Paging @security-eng — can you review the role and JIT constraints? Specifically: project-scoped custom role, `logging.logEntries.*` limited, JIT STS 1h, audit annotations required. :eyes: 

marta: If security-eng is ok, I'll open the JIT request and create the role PR. We'll also add a post-check that the role can't be used outside the prod project.

priya: Also add a short eval: run the redaction fuzz tests against a sample set to confirm nothing leaks. I can run those after PR.

alex: LGTM from infra side. One more ask: deny export privileges (`logging.sinks.create`, `storage.objects.create`) so logs can't be exfiltrated.

marta: Good call — will remove any sink/storage create perms.

oncall-bot: Action items captured: 1) marta: open IAM PR. 2) marta: file JIT template with 1h TTL and ticket requirement. 3) priya: run redaction tests after PR. 4) security-eng: review/approve.

marta: I'll do the PR now and ping here when ready. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
